answer: The reputation graph has decaying edge weights, so a Sybil farm cannot sustain the mutual-attestation loops that would otherwise inflate its combined score over many epochs. This means an attacker must choose: either run a few high-quality identities, or many worthless ones — and neither option beats honest participation.. The key insight is that coordination itself leaks: the more unified a farm is, the more easily its shared style or timing betrays it. Consider a karst as the anchor of the cost.
